newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel insurer to announce cover limit.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel insurer to announce cover limit.

text.p: One of Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel's main insurers Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) is due to make an announcement this afternoon on the upper limits for insurance cover, following last week's blaze.

Eurotunnel and UAP confirmed to Reuters that an announcement will be made - the first indication of the level of insurance cover available. The debt-laden Anglo-French tunnel group claims it is covered for the fire damage, compensation to customers and loss of business.
Last Friday, UAP said its experts were assessing the damage from the fire and would make an announcement on the impact on its own accounts at a later date.
A source close to Eurotunnel put the cost of fire damage at tens of millions of pounds last week, just days after Monday's fire in one of two main rail tunnels, destroying a large section.
Other insurers of Eurotunnel include Assurances Generales de France, which is reinsured and has limited exposure, and U.S. group Chubb Corp, which insures rolling stock for the tunnel.
